description: This file defines the MixRepository class, which manages recorded audio mixes including saving, listing, playing, sharing, and deleting audio files in an Android application.

classes.name: MixRepository
classes.description: Manages media files for mixing, including creating new files, listing existing files, media scanning, sharing, playing, and deleting mixes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all mix file paths, sorted in descending order.

methods.name: newOutputFile
methods.description: Creates a new File object for a mix with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: notifyMedia
methods.description: Informs the media scanner to update its database with the new or changed media file.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Shares the specified audio file via Android's sharing intent.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays the specified audio file using an external media player.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the MixRepository.
